dedupe_keys.name: egnos open service definition document sdd version 3 0

description: The EGNOS Open Service Service Definition Document, version 3.0 published on 12 November 2024 and in force, describes the augmentation service that EGNOS provides to the GPS Standard Positioning Service over Europe. Contents: the EGNOS system architecture and signal-in-space characteristics, the open service performance achieved, the technical and organisational framework at European level, complementary information on GNSS concepts, the GPS service, EGNOS management structure and user interfaces, and minimum performance characteristics; it does not cover the Safety of Life service or EDAS, which have separate documents. The page notes EGNOS presently augments GPS L1 C/A (1575.42 MHz) with correction data and integrity information. Audience: receiver manufacturers, application developers and users in agriculture, location-based services, mapping and surveying, maritime, rail and road. Producer: EGNOS user support, on behalf of EUSPA. Coverage: the European EGNOS service area. Access: a public 2.15 MB PDF. Licence and cost: free; the page states no reuse licence. Caveats: a specification of minimum performance, not measured availability, and other service documents cover safety-of-life and data access. Simulation uses: the definitions give the augmentation performance floor for positioning-dependent infrastructure resilience models. Related record: the Galileo and EGNOS reference documents index (data-galileo-egnos-programme-reference-documents).
